AWD (all-wheel drive) sends power to all four wheels automatically whenever the system senses slip, so you get extra grip on wet or snowy roads without doing anything. It’s different from 4x4, which you usually switch on yourself and is built more for off-road and deep snow.

results.say: do you think a jeep is good in chicago winters?
results.reply: Generally, yes — a 4x4 Jeep with good winter or all-season tires handles Chicago snow well, and ground clearance helps with unplowed streets. The tires matter as much as the drivetrain, and 4x4 helps you get going but doesn’t help you stop, so braking distances still grow on ice.
